title: Growing to Be Like Jesus
story:
A young apprentice joined a master carpenter to learn the craft.

On the first day, his work was rough and uneven.

Instead of criticizing him, the carpenter patiently taught him how to measure carefully, cut accurately, and polish every piece.

Day after day, the apprentice improved.

His hands became steadier, and his work began to resemble that of his teacher.

People who saw his furniture could tell who had trained him.

God works in a similar way with His children.

When we place our faith in Christ, He begins shaping our character.

Through every joy, challenge, success, and trial, God is making us more like Jesus.

The process takes time, but His work is always purposeful.

One day, we will perfectly reflect the image of His Son.
life_lesson: God's purpose is not only to bless us but to transform us into the likeness of Jesus Christ every day.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for patiently shaping my life.

Help me to trust You even when the process is difficult.

Mold my heart, my thoughts, and my actions to become more like Jesus.

May others see His love and character reflected through me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
In what area of your life is God shaping your character today?

How have past challenges helped you become more like Christ?

What is one practical way you can reflect Jesus to others this week?
verse: For those God foreknew He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, that He might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.
